macros.name: bash
macros.doc: The \bash command, offered by this package, takes all subsequent lines, stopping at the closing \END, places these in a file, and then lets the bash shell interpreter execute this file.

macros.name: bashStdout
macros.doc: After each execution of \bash, the macro \bashStdout is defined to entire contents of the standard output of the executed script.

macros.name: splice
macros.doc: Shell commands passed to the \splice macro are executed in a similar fashion to commands enclosed between \bash and \END, but, in addition to this execution, bashful incorporates the standard output into the main file.
